summary: Describes how to create concession groups, assign concessions to students, and view them in reports.
steps: Go to Fee Setup and create a concession group (e.g., "10% concession").
Define the concession type (e.g., percentage) and apply it to specific fee heads or terms (e.g., PAB, March).
The concession amount will automatically populate based on the group's definition.
Add or edit remarks if necessary.
business_rules: Concession groups must be set up first.
Concession amounts are automatically calculated based on the group's percentage/type.
important_notes: Assigned concessions are visible on the "collect fee" page and in the "Concession Report".
questions: How do I apply a fee concession to a student?
Where can I create concession groups?
Where can I view student concessions?
